modelingNotes: Carolina Goldrusher, Carowinds: procedural, CC0-1.0. bun generators/carowinds-carolina-goldrusher.ts (REPORT=1 for the element table)

Map frame: x east, y north, z up, metres; bearing 0. The origin is the middle of the track's footprint (see anchor), at the lowest ground under it. Built with ./coaster-kit.ts (a second chain lift, wooden bents, a tunnel).

Plan: the OSM circuit (way/669205940, way/895071507, way/895071508, way/895071510, way/895071511, way/895071512, way/895071506, way/895071509, way/891133321), 728 m in plan, from the station exit. The brief's table put way/895071506, way/895071511 and way/895071512 under Flying Cobras; they close this circuit.

Profile: an Arrow mine train (RCDB 83: 2,397 ft, two chain lifts, a tunnel; no published height). The lifts are the two long straights the OSM layers raise; heights are guesses kept low, as a mine train is:

station, elevated platform s 0, 3.5 m (from the photo) lift 1, 11 m s 104–157 (14–22%) turnaround, dip, helix 1 s 200–366, helix over the tunnel lift 2, 12.5 m s 384–455 (53–63%) helix 2, 1.5 turns, falling s 461–590 mine tunnel (way/895071506) s 630–700, drawn as a covered box
Photo (Wikimedia Commons): "Carolina Goldrusher 1" (2023, Jeremy Thompson, CC BY 2.0), matched by hand-placed camera. No other usable open photo of the ride was found.
Style: sage-grey tubular track on brown timber bents, as the photo shows.

Original procedural model from https://github.com/alexwohlbruck/landmarks (catalog id "carowinds-carolina-goldrusher", model "carowinds-carolina-goldrusher"), generated by https://github.com/alexwohlbruck/landmarks/blob/c3921f733df14b41e1f6d15853cce7b343886f17/generators/carowinds-carolina-goldrusher.ts. That repository is the editable source; source.blend.gz is the exported mesh imported into Blender for convenience.

Exported for Open Landmarks v1: placement bearing and scale baked in; moving parts frozen in their rest pose; footings and basements below the lowest ground (y = 0) cut away; material colours carried over exactly, as library finishes where they are not standard swatches.
